rubric_items.reason: Every changed path is now tested: REQ-5 changes fee, department and specialization and checks Completed, No-show and Cancelled; web tests cover Scheduled, Completed, Cancelled and No-show pages (previous F-1, F-2 resolved).
Assertions check exact shapes and rendered text. The REQ-7 and REQ-6 API tests still do not check that their setup PATCH succeeded, so they could pass without the Inactive state.
404 error path, Inactive specialization (API and web), Inactive department (web), paise edge and privacy are covered. Inactive department is only checked on the web side.
Vitest+Supertest on the throwaway test DB and Testing Library with MemoryRouter, as the strategy says. The EP-2/EP-4 test name still has no REQ id.
No counts or coverage invented; counts left to the verifier and checks.json shows coverage skipped (exit 78).
